'''2025 US Nationals Hayes Hunter LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2025 U.S. National Championship]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2025 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself (V)|V15-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open RTP Hunter LS 2025 US.txt |Download]]
